boundsMeaning: Conservative, dilated support of the retained heart. Non-intersecting source bricks are omitted; voxels outside fetched support remain zero.
registration: Section i samples original N5 s2 plane 4*i. First and last pixel centers match the current s4 physical center extent.
processing: Losslessly decode authentic uint16 source blocks, select the exact plane, linearly window to 8-bit display values, and preserve the documented mounting-container exclusion cylinder. No sharpening, generated texture, or in-plane upsampling.
limitations: 79.4 um is source sampling, not native 19.85 um resolution. Ultra sections are orthogonal planes loaded explicitly on demand. Public source connectivity is required for uncached data. A plane may require tens to hundreds of MB, depending on orientation and retained support. The display window is not raw quantitative intensity data.
